name: Shindou Touki
source: The protagonist of Tokyo Re:Connect. He moved from the countryside to Tokyo to start a new life. Living in an apartment with his older sister, he is a second-year male student attending Ainoshima Gakuen. While Touki doesn’t necessarily feel like socializing with anyone if it’s not required, he also yearns to make new friends.
